test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Describe how you will tell everyone that Mr. Akhil opened the gate in passive voice. **

options.text: The gate was opened by Mr.Akhil.
The gate been open by Mr.Akhil.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The gate was opened by Mr.Akhil. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In passive voice, the object (**the gate**) becomes the subject of the sentence and the subject (**Mr. Akhil**) becomes the object.
 
• The verb "**opened**" is changed to its past participle form "**was opened**".
 
• The phrase "**by Mr. Akhil**" is added to indicate who performed the action.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Mr. Akhil open the gate**" is incorrect because it is in active voice and the verb tense is incorrect.
 
• "**The gate been open by Mr. Akhil**" is incorrect because the verb tense is incorrect and the word "been" is unnecessary.
 
• "**The gate opened by Mr. Akhil**" is grammatically correct but it is missing the auxiliary verb "was" to indicate passive voice.
